items.title: Butch Cage and Robert Pete Williams Interview, 1967-05-13
items.q: [INTERVIEWER] Did you ever see Memphis Minnie? No.

ctx.x: No, sir. I saw a lot of them up there, and I forgot what they call her. She's got to play like Mama. She can't get off.
Was she about the same, about as big as Memphis Minnie? Yeah, yeah. About like Memphis Minnie, a big woman? Yeah.
She got on the stage and she saw her.
